proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5889.1 explicitly lists nominative Kalasha tu, Khowar tu and Gawri tu, as well as Hindi tū, Punjabi tū̃, Marathi tū̃ and other regional singular pronouns. The addendum confirms Khowar nominative tu versus oblique ta. Honorific/formal labels do not change the nominative family; analogical remodeling is acknowledged in the article.
